annotations.title: Find an event by a book, ESPN or MLB id

description: Free-tier endpoint. Reverse id lookup: give a sportsbook's own event id (book + book_event_id, e.g. book='pinnacle'), an ESPN event id or an MLB gamePk and get PropLine's event back with its full id crosswalk, status, completed flag and final score. Any date. Up to 50 comma-separated ids; misses come back in not_found. Useful for: 'what was the result of Pinnacle event 1612345678', 'which PropLine event is this ESPN game'.

book.description: Book key, e.g. pinnacle, draftkings, kalshi.
